test_title: PYST 33: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: In an election between two candidates, 80% of the registered voters cast their votes. Out of these, 2% were declared invalid. One candidate secured 8,820 votes, which accounted for 75% of the valid votes. Find the total number of registered voters.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total voters = x

Successive percentage equation: x × 80% × 98% × 75% = 8,820

x × (4/5) × (49/50) × (3/4) = 8,820

x × 147/250 = 8,820

x = 60 × 250 = 15,000

**∴ The correct answer is 15,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Voters cast = 80% | Invalid votes = 2% (Valid = 98%) | Candidate share = 75% of valid votes | Candidate votes = 8,820

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c6089ecdfbf996e463f0746b0bd5412bd7631291521e2435a4e76e7dd2c39ce.png] 

⇒ Let total registered voters = x

⇒ Number of cast votes = 0.80 × x

⇒ Number of valid votes = 98% of (0.80 × x) = 0.98 × 0.80 × x

⇒ Winning candidate's votes = 75% of valid votes

⇒ 0.75 × (0.98 × 0.80 × x) = 8,820

⇒ 0.75 × 0.784x = 8,820

⇒ 0.588x = 8,820

⇒ x = 8,820 ÷ 0.588

⇒ x = 15,000

**∴ The correct answer is 15,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Application

When multiple percentages are applied to a base value in sequence, the final value = Base × (P₁/100) × (P₂/100) × ... × (Pₙ/100).

Election Terminology

Valid Votes = Total Cast Votes − Invalid Votes. Winning Margin = (Winner% − Loser%) × Valid Votes.

Fractional Conversion Shortcuts

Using fractions simplifies calculation: 80% = 4/5, 75% = 3/4, 25% = 1/4, 20% = 1/5.
